meaning.en: Aruni, son of Prajapati
meaning.hi: प्रजापति-पुत्र आरुणि

meaning.en: went to Prajapati's world
meaning.hi: प्रजापति के लोक को गए

meaning.en: Lord, by what means do I give up rites completely
meaning.hi: भगवन्, किस उपाय से मैं कर्मों को पूरी तरह त्यागूँ

meaning.en: sons, brothers, relatives and so on
meaning.hi: पुत्र, भाई, नातेदार आदि

meaning.en: the hair-tuft and the sacred thread
meaning.hi: चोटी और जनेऊ

meaning.en: ritual offering and private recitation
meaning.hi: यज्ञ और स्वाध्याय

meaning.en: the seven worlds above, bhur through satya
meaning.hi: ऊपर के सात लोक, भूः से सत्य तक

meaning.en: the seven regions below
meaning.hi: नीचे के सात तल

meaning.en: and he should give up the whole universe
meaning.hi: और समूचा ब्रह्मांड त्याग दे

words.sanskrit: daṇḍam ācchādanaṁ ca eva kaupīnaṁ ca parigrahet

meaning.en: he may keep only a staff, a covering cloth, and a loincloth
meaning.hi: केवल दंड, ओढ़ने का कपड़ा और लँगोटी रखे

meaning.en: he should give up all the rest
meaning.hi: बाक़ी सब त्याग दे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whether householder, student, or forest-dweller
meaning.hi: चाहे गृहस्थ, ब्रह्मचारी या वानप्रस्थ

meaning.en: should release the sacred thread into earth or water
meaning.hi: जनेऊ को धरती या जल में विसर्जित करे

meaning.en: should merge the household fires into the fire of his own belly
meaning.hi: लौकिक अग्नियों को पेट की अग्नि में समाए

meaning.en: and merge the Gayatri into that fire through his own speech
meaning.hi: और गायत्री को अपनी वाणी से उसी अग्नि में समाए

meaning.en: the hut-dwelling renunciate and the student should give up family
meaning.hi: कुटीचर और ब्रह्मचारी परिवार त्यागें

meaning.en: give up the bowl, give up the strainer
meaning.hi: पात्र त्यागें, पवित्र (छन्नी) त्यागें

meaning.en: give up staffs and the thought of worlds to be won
meaning.hi: दंड और लोकों को त्यागें

meaning.en: from then on he should live without reciting mantras
meaning.hi: उसके बाद बिना मंत्र के आचरण करे

meaning.en: he should treat food the way one treats medicine
meaning.hi: भोजन को दवा की तरह ले

meaning.en: he should perform the true joining within himself in deep meditation
meaning.hi: संधि को अपने भीतर समाधि में साधे

meaning.en: he should recite the forest texts, recite the Upanishad
meaning.hi: आरण्यक दोहराए, उपनिषद् दोहराए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: brahma-sūcanāt sūtraṁ brahma-sūtram aham eva vidvān

meaning.en: since it points to brahman, the thread is brahman's own thread, and I who know am that brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म-सूचक होने से सूत्र ब्रह्म का ही सूत्र है, और मैं ज्ञानी वही हूँ

meaning.en: the knower should throw away the three-stranded thread
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी तीन लड़ों वाला सूत्र त्यागे

meaning.en: "I have given it up" (said three times)
meaning.hi: "मैंने त्याग दिया" (तीन बार कहकर)

meaning.en: there is no fear from me for any creature
meaning.hi: सब प्राणियों के लिए अभय

meaning.en: everything proceeds out of me
meaning.hi: मुझसे ही सब प्रवर्तित होता है

meaning.en: friend, guard my strength
meaning.hi: मित्र, मेरे बल की रक्षा करो

meaning.en: you are Indra's thunderbolt, slayer of Vritra
meaning.hi: तुम इंद्र के वज्र हो, वृत्रघ्न हो

meaning.en: be a shelter to me
meaning.hi: मेरे लिए शरण बनो

meaning.en: turn away whatever wrong there is
meaning.hi: जो पाप है उसे दूर करो

meaning.en: he should take up a bamboo staff and a loincloth
meaning.hi: बाँस का दंड और लँगोटी ग्रहण करे

words.sanskrit: brahmacaryam ahiṁsā ca aparigrahaṁ ca satyaṁ ca yatnena rakṣata

meaning.en: guard with effort: celibacy, non-harming, ownerlessness, and truth
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मचर्य, अहिंसा, अपरिग्रह और सत्य की यत्नपूर्वक रक्षा करो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: of the supreme wandering renunciates
meaning.hi: परमहंस परिव्राजकों के लिए

meaning.en: sitting, lying down, and so on should be on the ground
meaning.hi: बैठना-लेटना आदि भूमि पर हो

meaning.en: celibacy is kept, and the bowl is of clay, gourd, or wood
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मचर्य, और पात्र मिट्टी, तूँबे या लकड़ी का

meaning.en: craving, anger, elation, sudden rage, greed, delusion
meaning.hi: काम, क्रोध, हर्ष, रोष, लोभ, मोह

meaning.en: should give up pretence, arrogance, craving, envy, possessiveness, egoism, and the like
meaning.hi: दंभ, दर्प, इच्छा, असूया, ममत्व, अहंकार आदि त्यागे

meaning.en: in the rainy season he stays settled in one practice
meaning.hi: बारिश में एक ही स्वभाव से टिका रहे

meaning.en: for eight months the renunciate should wander alone
meaning.hi: आठ महीने यति अकेला घूमे

meaning.en: or else two together may wander
meaning.hi: या फिर दो साथ घूमें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: truly, one who understands it this way
meaning.hi: सचमुच, जो इस प्रकार जानता है

words.sanskrit: sa-upanayanāt ūrdhvam etāni prāk vā tyajet

meaning.en: should give these up after being led to the teacher, or even before
meaning.hi: उपनयन के बाद इन्हें त्यागे, या उससे भी पहले

words.sanskrit: pitraṁ putram agni upavītaṁ karma kalatraṁ ca anyat api

meaning.en: father, son, fire, sacred thread, ritual duty, wife, and whatever else
meaning.hi: पिता, पुत्र, अग्नि, जनेऊ, कर्म, पत्नी और जो कुछ और

meaning.en: renunciates enter a village for the purpose of alms
meaning.hi: यति भिक्षा के लिए गाँव में प्रवेश करते हैं

meaning.en: using the hand as bowl, or the stomach as bowl
meaning.hi: हाथ को पात्र या पेट को पात्र बनाकर

words.sanskrit: om hi om hi om hi iti

meaning.en: Om, so be it; Om, so be it; Om, so be it
meaning.hi: ॐ ही, ॐ ही, ॐ ही

meaning.en: thus one should set down this Upanishad
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार यह उपनिषद् रख दे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: khalu etat upaniṣadaṁ vidvān ya evaṁ veda

meaning.en: truly, one who knows this Upanishad, who understands it this way
meaning.hi: सचमुच, जो इस उपनिषद् को जानता है, जो इस प्रकार समझता है

meaning.en: a staff of flame-of-the-forest wood, bael, pipal, or cluster-fig
meaning.hi: पलाश, बेल, पीपल या गूलर का दंड

meaning.en: having thrown away the munja-grass belt and the sacred thread
meaning.hi: मूँज की मेखला और जनेऊ त्यागकर

meaning.en: the brave one, who understands it this way
meaning.hi: वही शूर, जो इस प्रकार जानता है

words.sanskrit: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padaṁ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ

meaning.en: the wise always behold that highest step of Vishnu
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी सदा विष्णु के उस परम पद को देखते हैं

meaning.en: spread across the sky like an open eye
meaning.hi: आकाश में फैली हुई आँख के समान

meaning.en: the inspired, wide-awake singers kindle that light into flame
meaning.hi: प्रेरित, जागे हुए गायक उस ज्योति को प्रज्वलित करते हैं

meaning.en: such is the teaching of final release, the teaching of the Veda
meaning.hi: ऐसी है निर्वाण की शिक्षा, वेद की शिक्षा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
